translations.web: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.
translations.bsb: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws that the LORD established between Himself and the Israelites through Moses on Mount Sinai.
translations.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
translations.asv: These are the statutes and ordinances and laws, which Jehovah made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by Moses.
